evidence_levels.SOURCE-VERIFIED: Official source or primary publication supports the source-level statement; does not by itself verify released file semantics.
evidence_levels.AUTHOR-REPORTED: Statement made by an author or data publisher; not independently verified inside data files.
evidence_levels.THIRD-PARTY-CLAIM: Claim made by a non-author third-party data card or repackaging page.
evidence_levels.METADATA-INSPECTED: Public page or read-only API metadata inspected; no asset content inspected.
evidence_levels.FILE-INSPECTED: File-level evidence inherited only within the cited earlier task scope.
evidence_levels.UNKNOWN: No sufficient evidence in reviewed sources; not equivalent to absence.

sources.prior_evidence: CMRL-09 reviewed collection and paper sources; CMRL-04 through CMRL-08 contain bounded local/metadata audit evidence.
sources.license_claim: CC BY 4.0 for TCIA images as recorded in prior official-source review.
sources.annotated_structures: The paper reports tumor and uterus delineation on reference T2; no released RTSTRUCT ROI-to-structure crosswalk found.
sources.access_this_task: No raw files or local data accessed; direct page read unavailable; prior evidence reused within scope.

sources.publisher_generic_redistribution_claim: Card states that images are from public datasets with a license for redistribution; no CCTH-specific derivative-label rights chain identified.
sources.source_data_license: TCIA CCTH original source recorded as CC BY 4.0 in prior review; derivative rights/applicability unresolved.
sources.publisher_processing_claim: All labeled slices extracted and preprocessed into NPZ; imgs/gts described as (D,H,W); image intensity described as [0,255]; spacing key described.
sources.cohort_relation: CCTH-derived naming indicates potential same source cohort; exact subject mapping unverified; not independent validation.

sources.official_source_size_recorded_in_prior_r: 28.39 GB; publication/page accounting differences remain unresolved.
sources.roi_timepoint_and_series_mapping_claim: Third-party-only; not confirmed by TCIA, Bowen authors, or a published conversion/crosswalk source.
sources.cohort_relation: Repository explicitly identifies the CCTH source; treat as a repackaging, never as an independent cohort.

sources.prior_file_audit: CMRL-01/02: 2D image/mask package checked; no patient/site mapping established; duplicates found across splits.
sources.physical_3d_metadata: Not supplied by the inspected 2D raster package.

sources.repository_access_condition: Email with institution and purpose, followed by password approval.
sources.file_format_claim_conflict: DICOM plus PNG versus NRRD examples in the README.

sources.author_description: 94 cervical-cancer cases, 3D T2 MRI, OAR contours; no primary-tumor mask source statement found.

sources.asset_type_claim: Multi-sequence 3D MRI, reports, and FIGO staging; not described as GTV segmentation masks.
sources.access_claim: Author response says researchers may apply by email.

sources.scope_exclusion: Head-and-neck primary tumors are not cervical primary tumors; excluded by Plan.
